overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that changing the default from `= []` to `Field(default=[])` would preserve the same mutable default behavior, but pydantic's `defer_build` mechanism means the class attribute is not initialized until first access, so `Field(default=[])` creates a fresh list per instance only after the model is built, while the old `= []` shared the same class-level list until the model was first instantiated. Under concurrent load on a fresh worker, the class-level list is never pre-seeded, and the first concurrent access triggers a build race or leaves attributes unavailable, causing the `use_litellm_proxy` missing error.
why_it_breaks: The diff replaced `workers: list[WorkerRegistryEntry] = []` with `Field(default=[])`. Under pydantic's `defer_build` (default true), the model schema is not built until the first instance is created. The old `= []` set a class-level empty list that existed immediately at class definition time, so even before the model was 'built', the attribute was present. The new `Field(default=[])` defers the creation of that list until the model is first instantiated or accessed. On a fresh worker under concurrent load, the first burst of requests may trigger the build in a way that leaves `CredentialLiteLLMParams` (or related models) without the `use_litellm_proxy` attribute because the model's internal initialization path didn't populate it before the concurrent request tried to read it. Later requests succeed because the model is now built. The agent overlooked that moving the default to `Field` changes when the attribute is first available relative to pydantic's deferred build lifecycle.
